'''Enterprise Commons''' was a large garden park located in the [[Incorporation Islands]] district of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It was bordered on the west and south by [[Mainland Boulevard]] and [[Capital Way]] respectively, and during the [[Battle of Corellia]] it saw fighting between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the forces of [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]].<ref name="TOR" />
